SlopIsolate · Beta

SlopIsolate: background remover

Remove backgrounds with AI that runs on your device.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Watch the SlopIsolate tutorial: remove backgrounds in the browser
On YouTube, about two minutes.

SlopIsolate has these main features: One-click AI background removal; Refine brush & soft edges. It opens Any image.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with SlopIsolate

  • Bulk background remover: hundreds of images at once
  • White background for product photos
  • Make a transparent PNG from any picture
  • Remove the background from a video
